They hold the mind firmly. They make perfect aspirations. They generate faith so that unarisen wholesome qualities may arise. They exert effort. They initiate diligent perseverance.

They hold the mind firmly. They make perfect aspirations. They generate faith so that arisen wholesome qualities may remain, not decline, increase, expand, develop, and reach full perfection. They exert effort. They initiate diligent perseverance. They hold the mind firmly. They make perfect aspirations.

They cultivate the base of miraculous power <note>original: *rddhipada*</note> associated with the formative factors that abandon the meditative concentration of desire, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, and dwelling in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment. They cultivate the base of miraculous power associated with the formative factors that abandon the meditative concentration of diligent perseverance, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in cessation, dwelling in cessation. They cultivate it, fully accomplished through abandonment of dwelling in detachment from diligent perseverance and dwelling in cessation. They cultivate the meditative concentration of the mind, associated with the formative factors that abandon it, the base of miraculous power dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, established in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment, and they cultivate investigation. They cultivate meditative concentration.

They cultivate the power of mindfulness, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, dwelling in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment. They cultivate the power of meditative concentration, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, dwelling in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment. They cultivate the power of wisdom, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, dwelling in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment.

They cultivate the enlightenment factor of perfect mindfulness, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, dwelling in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment. They cultivate the enlightenment factor of perfect discrimination of phenomena, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, dwelling in cessation, fully accomplished through abandonment. They cultivate the enlightenment factor of perfect diligent perseverance, dwelling in seclusion, dwelling in detachment from desire, fully accomplished through abandonment.

<summary>This text outlines the meditative practices and mental disciplines required for the path to enlightenment, focusing on the cultivation of faith, effort, the bases of miraculous power, and the factors of enlightenment.</summary>
